subtitle: Automated Discord Release Announcer
changes: Added a GitHub Actions release notifier that follows successful main-branch release validation and announces new published PROXIMUS versions to Discord automatically
Created branded Discord embeds with the true release changelog, version, published status, GitHub release notes and application link
Protected Discord webhook credentials through an encrypted DISCORD_RELEASE_WEBHOOK GitHub Actions secret; credentials are never placed in public code
Verified that GitHub Pages serves the new version before posting and prevented ordinary commits, pull requests, failed checks or repeated version numbers from triggering notifications
Added a safe manual dry-run preview and a Send current release action for testing a channel after the encrypted webhook secret is configured
Preserved PROXIMUS Companion Edition, its 23 active studios, Video Vault, Reactor IV, existing user data, Token Foundry and prior rollback releases
